answer_1.quote: Serving as a structural representation, AMR has been shown useful for NLP tasks such as text summarization , machine translation , information extraction  and dialogue systems .

answer_2.quote: Regarding AMR-to-text, we use three common Natural Language Generation measures, including BLEU , CHRF++  and METEOR (Banerjee and Lavie, 2005), tokenizing with the script provided with JAMR .
